apply: Insert the exact block into Canonical's 177+177 successor immediately before its capacity-contracts artifact upload and after the successful helper. Baseline context is provided for review only; Canonical owns the helper/source pins/evidence-directory and180min job changes.
retention: Canonical's always artifact upload for ci-capacity-profile-contracts retains these bounded JSON/text native additions. Native raw temporary capture is removed by this step.
runtime_route: Installed setupPython package; exact native_runtime50ca returnsNone if no interpreter-prefix bundle/supplement. Preflight requires this route, actual WXMSW, CPython3.11 x64, exact source/wheel hashes; no audio dependency or Windows11/NVDA/bundled-runtime claim.
runtime: NOT_RUN; no PowerShell/Python parser or Windows execution claim.
insert:
- name: Require real installed Windows complete-backup controls and restore
        id: native_backup_capacity
        if: ${{ success() && runner.os == 'Windows' }}
        timeout-minutes: 5
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false
          $python = (Get-Command python -ErrorAction Stop).Source
          $nativeEvidence = Join-Path (Get-Location) 'ci-capacity-profile-contracts/native-backup'
          $nativeCapture = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP ('carr-native-backup-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N') + '.txt')
          $verifyNativeBackupCapacity = @'
          from hashlib import sha1, sha256
          import importlib, json, os, pathlib, platform, re, struct, subprocess, sys, traceback
          
          MODULES = ["carr_library.application","carr_library.backup_capacity","carr_library.library_backup","carr_library.pending_backup","carr_library.backup_sidecars","carr_library.storage.revisions","carr_library.ingest.catalog_asset_copy","carr_library.ui.backup_capacity","carr_library.ui.desktop_app","carr_library.ui.worker_lifetime","carr_library.durable_state","carr_library.native_runtime"]
          REQUIRED = set(["native failure answers owned No before closing only the active inner modal","restored-library opening uses actual default-No native confirmation","capacity dialog starts with the ordinary allowance","native checksum entry preserves the exact retained manifest identity","native completion retains focused readable result","real native Windows controls","existing host executor owns backup work and finalizers","actual backup executes on the shared worker","actual restore executes on the shared worker","native capacity cancellation opens no folder or worker","ordinary and large selections reach the real canonical backup","backup result explicitly includes validated unfinished imports","native backup presents the independently retainable manifest checksum","selected allowance preserves complete4 and pending1 wire","explicit large restore reaches the same canonical fresh-destination API","real restored library preserves both retained originals and search","default-No restore leaves the original LibraryApp active","native backup menus dispatch the existing host workflow","native host Close drains the actual executor without retained failure","native failure cleanup control completed","exact installed source: carr_library.application","unchanged installed source after cleanup: carr_library.application","exact installed source: carr_library.backup_capacity","unchanged installed source after cleanup: carr_library.backup_capacity","exact installed source: carr_library.library_backup","unchanged installed source after cleanup: carr_library.library_backup","exact installed source: carr_library.pending_backup","unchanged installed source after cleanup: carr_library.pending_backup","exact installed source: carr_library.backup_sidecars","unchanged installed source after cleanup: carr_library.backup_sidecars","exact installed source: carr_library.storage.revisions","unchanged installed source after cleanup: carr_library.storage.revisions","exact installed source: carr_library.ingest.catalog_asset_copy","unchanged installed source after cleanup: carr_library.ingest.catalog_asset_copy","exact installed source: carr_library.ui.backup_capacity","unchanged installed source after cleanup: carr_library.ui.backup_capacity","exact installed source: carr_library.ui.desktop_app","unchanged installed source after cleanup: carr_library.ui.desktop_app","exact installed source: carr_library.ui.worker_lifetime","unchanged installed source after cleanup: carr_library.ui.worker_lifetime","exact installed source: carr_library.durable_state","unchanged installed source after cleanup: carr_library.durable_state","exact installed source: carr_library.native_runtime","unchanged installed source after cleanup: carr_library.native_runtime"])
          PINS = {"scripts/windows_backup_capacity_smoke.py":"dffdce9ac49fcb54cd2393f410f0844ad9c52130","src/carr_library/backup_capacity.py":"1fd11ab8d3a2be5434e32bdcba65447c55730ad7","src/carr_library/storage/revisions.py":"417a9920d4c25eacd36cc81f7441ea321c18d632","src/carr_library/library_backup.py":"d36d2ab93043bff46048bb6146769a1a19f29db8","src/carr_library/pending_backup.py":"b2c3fc3a52e9d2fef5c019196ef239381c519fc7","src/carr_library/backup_sidecars.py":"5c2ec87913e8ad252dce9aa8cff7ccc22dca3525","src/carr_library/ui/backup_capacity.py":"66555889648ec8b76ac11e7ffe5bd54ece6c29e9","src/carr_library/native_runtime.py":"50ca93914325753f7d9cb91f1bc4f48fc9ae230f"}
          FIELDS = {
              'status':'PASS', 'native_keyboard':'PASS', 'native_backup_restore':'PASS',
              'native_failure_cleanup':'PASS', 'native_host_cleanup':'PASS',
              'large_corpus_measurement':'NOT_RUN', 'manual_nvda':'NOT_RUN',
              'physical_media':'NOT_RUN', 'power_loss':'NOT_RUN',
              'folder_picker':'explicit fixture selections; system picker not automated',
          }
          MAX_LOG = 8 * 1024 * 1024
          mode, evidence_arg, log_arg, exit_arg, before_digest = sys.argv[1:]
          assert mode in ('before', 'after')
          evidence = pathlib.Path(evidence_arg)
          before_path, final_path = evidence/'preflight.json', evidence/'native-backup-capacity.json'
          checkout = pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve(strict=True)
          source_root = checkout/'src'
          
          def require(value, message):
              if not value:
                  raise AssertionError(message)
          
          def blob(raw):
              return sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(raw)).encode('ascii') + b'\0' + raw).hexdigest()
          
          def git(*arguments):
              value = subprocess.run(['git', *arguments], cwd=checkout, capture_output=True,
                                     text=True, encoding='utf-8', timeout=20, check=True)
              return value.stdout.strip()
          
          def file_proof(path):
              info = path.lstat()
              require(path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink() and info.st_nlink == 1,
                      'Proof input is not a private regular file: ' + str(path))
              raw = path.read_bytes()
              require(len(raw) == info.st_size, 'Proof input changed size.')
              return dict(bytes=len(raw), sha256=sha256(raw).hexdigest(), git_blob=blob(raw))
          
          def snapshot():
              require(sys.platform == 'win32' and sys.version_info[:2] == (3, 11)
                      and struct.calcsize('P') == 8, 'This gate requires actual Windows x64 / CPython 3.11.')
              require(git('rev-parse', 'HEAD') == os.environ['EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA'],
                      'Capacity checkout differs from its expected source commit.')
              from carr_library.native_runtime import activate_bundled_runtime
              handle = activate_bundled_runtime()
              if handle is not None:
                  handle.close()
                  raise AssertionError('Expected installed setupPython route, found a bundled runtime supplement.')
              import wx
              require(wx.Platform == '__WXMSW__', 'Actual Windows wx controls are required.')
              source, installed = {}, {}
              for name in MODULES:
                  path = source_root.joinpath(*name.split('.')).with_suffix('.py')
                  relative = path.relative_to(checkout).as_posix()
                  item = file_proof(path)
                  require(item['git_blob'] == git('rev-parse', os.environ['EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA'] + ':carr-library/' + relative),
                          'Source module differs from the exact commit: ' + name)
                  if relative in PINS:
                      require(item['git_blob'] == PINS[relative], 'Reviewed source pin differs: ' + name)
                  actual = pathlib.Path(importlib.import_module(name).__file__).resolve(strict=True)
                  require(actual.is_relative_to(pathlib.Path(sys.prefix).resolve())
                          and not actual.is_relative_to(source_root), 'Module did not come from the installed wheel: ' + name)
                  actual_item = file_proof(actual)
                  require(actual_item == item, 'Installed/source module bytes differ: ' + name)
                  source[name] = dict(path=relative, **item)
                  installed[name] = dict(path=str(actual), **actual_item)
              probe = checkout/'scripts/windows_backup_capacity_smoke.py'
              probe_item = file_proof(probe)
              require(probe_item['git_blob'] == PINS['scripts/windows_backup_capacity_smoke.py']
                      == git('rev-parse', os.environ['EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA'] + ':carr-library/scripts/windows_backup_capacity_smoke.py'),
                      'Exact reviewed native probe differs.')
              executable = pathlib.Path(sys.executable).resolve(strict=True)
              return dict(source_commit=os.environ['EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA'], source_tree=git('rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}'),
                  source=source, installed=installed, probe=probe_item,
                  python=dict(path=str(executable), version=sys.version, sha256=sha256(executable.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                              prefix=str(pathlib.Path(sys.prefix).resolve())),
                  wx=dict(version=wx.version(), platform=wx.Platform),
                  host=dict(platform=platform.platform(), windows_version=list(platform.win32_ver()),
                            windows_edition=platform.win32_edition()),
                  route='verified application wheel in setupPython; optional bundled supplement absent',
                  windows11_qualification='NOT_RUN', bundled_runtime_qualification='NOT_RUN',
                  audio_or_model_input='NONE')
          
          if mode == 'before':
              require(not evidence.exists(), 'Native proof needs a fresh evidence directory.')
              current = snapshot()
              evidence.mkdir(parents=True)
              with before_path.open('x', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as stream:
                  json.dump(current, stream, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2)
                  stream.write('\n')
              print(json.dumps(dict(status='READY', source_commit=current['source_commit'],
                                    installed_origins=len(current['installed']), route=current['route']), ensure_ascii=True))
          else:
              result = dict(status='FAIL', source_commit=os.environ['EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA'],
                            native_execution='NOT_QUALIFIED', windows11_qualification='NOT_RUN',
                            bundled_runtime_qualification='NOT_RUN', process_exit_code=int(exit_arg))
              try:
                  require(before_path.is_file() and not before_path.is_symlink(), 'Native preflight proof is missing.')
                  before_raw = before_path.read_bytes()
                  require(len(before_raw) <= 1024*1024 and sha256(before_raw).hexdigest() == before_digest,
                          'Native preflight proof changed.')
                  before = json.loads(before_raw.decode('utf-8'))
                  log = pathlib.Path(log_arg)
                  require(log.is_file() and not log.is_symlink() and log.stat().st_nlink == 1,
                          'Native process log is missing or linked.')
                  with log.open('rb') as stream:
                      raw = stream.read(MAX_LOG + 1)
                  require(len(raw) <= MAX_LOG, 'Native process log exceeds the finite retention limit.')
                  text = raw.decode('utf-8-sig')
                  with (evidence/'native-backup-capacity.txt').open('x', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as stream:
                      stream.write(text)
                  current = snapshot()
                  require(current == before, 'Source, installed modules, selected interpreter or runtime changed during native work.')
                  require(int(exit_arg) == 0, 'The actual native backup process failed.')
                  reports = []
                  for match in re.finditer(r'(?m)^\{', text):
                      try:
                          value, _ = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(text[match.start():])
                      except ValueError:
                          continue
                      if type(value) is dict and 'native_backup_restore' in value:
                          reports.append(value)
                  require(len(reports) == 1, 'Actual native report is missing or ambiguous.')
                  report = reports[0]
                  require(all(type(report.get(key)) is type(value) and report.get(key) == value
                              for key, value in FIELDS.items()), 'Required native outcome/limitation field differs.')
                  checks = report.get('checks')
                  require(type(checks) is list and all(type(name) is str for name in checks),
                          'Native checks are invalid.')
                  require(len(REQUIRED) == 44 and REQUIRED <= set(checks),
                          'Required native checks are missing: ' + repr(sorted(REQUIRED - set(checks))))
                  origins = report.get('origins')
                  require(type(origins) is dict and set(origins) == set(MODULES) and len(origins) == 12,
                          'Native source origin inventory differs.')
                  require(all(origins[name] == before['source'][name]['sha256'] for name in MODULES),
                          'Native module identities differ from the exact selected source.')
                  result = dict(report, source_commit=before['source_commit'], source_tree=before['source_tree'],
                      runtime_route=before['route'], runtime=before['python'], host=before['host'], wx=before['wx'],
                      preflight_sha256=before_digest, process_exit_code=0,
                      source_and_installed_before_after='PASS', required_checks=44, installed_origins=12,
                      windows11_qualification='NOT_RUN', bundled_runtime_qualification='NOT_RUN')
              except Exception as error:
                  result.update(error_type=type(error).__name__, error=str(error))
                  print(traceback.format_exc(), file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
              with final_path.open('x', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as stream:
                  json.dump(result, stream, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2)
                  stream.write('\n')
              require(set(path.name for path in evidence.iterdir()) <= {
                          'preflight.json','native-backup-capacity.json','native-backup-capacity.txt'},
                      'Unexpected native evidence file.')
              require(all(path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink() and path.stat().st_nlink == 1
                          and path.stat().st_size <= MAX_LOG for path in evidence.iterdir()),
                      'Native evidence is not a bounded JSON/text-only inventory.')
              print(json.dumps(dict(status=result['status'], source_commit=result['source_commit'],
                                    required_checks=44, installed_origins=12,
                                    native_execution='PASS' if result['status']=='PASS' else 'FAIL',
                                    windows11_qualification='NOT_RUN', bundled_runtime_qualification='NOT_RUN'),
                               ensure_ascii=True), flush=True)
              raise SystemExit(0 if result['status'] == 'PASS' else 1)
          '@
          try {
            $verifyNativeBackupCapacity | & $python -I -B -X utf8 - before $nativeEvidence $nativeCapture 0 '-'
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Installed native backup preflight source/runtime proof failed.' }
            $beforeNativeHash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $nativeEvidence 'preflight.json') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
            & $python -I -B -X utf8 scripts/windows_backup_capacity_smoke.py --source-root (Join-Path (Get-Location) 'src') 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $nativeCapture
            $nativeExit = $LASTEXITCODE
            $verifyNativeBackupCapacity | & $python -I -B -X utf8 - after $nativeEvidence $nativeCapture $nativeExit $beforeNativeHash
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Required independent installed Windows backup proof failed.' }
          } finally {
            if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $nativeCapture) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $nativeCapture -Force -ErrorAction Stop }
          }
